extracted.intended_audience: publishers/websites and readers considering republishing Forward articles
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and conditions for third parties to republish this Forward story, including eligibility, required attribution, technical requirements (tracking pixel, canonical/noindex tags), and image/HTML handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility for free republishing
rubrics_metrics.description: We’re happy to make this story available to republish for free, unless it originated with JTA, Haaretz or another publication (as indicated on the article) and as long as you follow our guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check the article for any indication that it originated from another publication (e.g., JTA, Haaretz); such stories may not be available for free republication. Follow the Forward’s full republishing guidelines for specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Credit the Forward
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The republished story must include credit to the Forward (the provided HTML includes the author byline and credit).

rubrics_metrics.name: Retain the Forward tracking pixel
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When copying the provided HTML (via the yellow button), do not remove the Forward’s tracking pixel — it is included intentionally and must remain in the republished page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preserve the canonical link
rubrics_metrics.description: Preserve our canonical link in Google search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep the canonical URL metadata as provided so Google attributes the story properly to the Forward.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add a noindex tag
rubrics_metrics.description: Add a noindex tag in Google search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a noindex tag on the republished page so search engines do not index the duplicate content; follow the Forward’s guidance on canonical/noindex handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use provided HTML (includes styles, links, byline, but excludes images)
rubrics_metrics.description: To republish, copy the HTML by clicking on the yellow button to the right; it includes our tracking pixel, all paragraph styles and hyperlinks, the author byline and credit to the Forward. It does not include images; to avoid copyright violations, you must add them manually, following our guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided HTML to ensure correct formatting and attribution. Do not assume images are included — add images yourself and follow the Forward’s image/copyright rules as specified in their full guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow the Forward’s full republishing guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: You must comply with the following: Credit the Forward; Retain our pixel; Preserve our canonical link in Google search; Add a noindex tag in Google search. See our full guidelines for more information, and this guide for detail about canonical URLs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the Forward’s full guidelines and the detailed canonical-URL guide linked from the republish section for any additional technical or legal requirements not listed in the short checklist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact Forward for questions or to notify about republication
rubrics_metrics.description: Please email us at [email protected], subject line “republish,” with any questions or to let us know what stories you’re picking up.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided contact address and subject line for inquiries or to inform the Forward which stories you will republish; this appears to be requested although the page does not state that notification is mandatory.
